name: macwhisper
title: MacWhisper
description: Transcribe audio and video on-device with MacWhisper: subtitles and translations, AI summaries and chapters, meeting notes, folder watching and Raycast AI tools.
author: xjo_nd

commands.name: transcribe-file
commands.title: Transcribe File
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Transcribe one or more audio or video files with your choice of model, language and format.

commands.name: transcribe-finder-selection
commands.title: Transcribe Finder Selection
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Transcribe the files selected in Finder and copy the transcript to the clipboard.

commands.name: transcribe-latest-recording
commands.title: Transcribe Latest Recording
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Transcribe the newest audio or video file from your recording folders.

commands.name: summarize-recording
commands.title: Summarize Recording
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Transcribe a recording and let Raycast AI summarize it, extract action items, translate it or draft a follow-up email.

commands.name: generate-subtitles
commands.title: Generate Subtitles
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Create SRT or VTT subtitles next to the videos selected in Finder.

preferences.name: subtitleFormat
preferences.title: Subtitle Format
preferences.description: File format of the generated subtitles.

preferences.name: maxCharsPerLine
preferences.title: Max Characters per Line
preferences.description: Wrap subtitle lines at this many characters. Leave empty for MacWhisper's default.

preferences.name: overwriteSubtitles
preferences.title: Existing Subtitles
preferences.label: Overwrite existing subtitle files
preferences.description: When off, videos that already have a subtitle file are skipped.

commands.name: translate-subtitles
commands.title: Translate Subtitles
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Generate subtitles with MacWhisper and translate them with Raycast AI while keeping the timecodes.

commands.name: batch-transcribe-folder
commands.title: Batch Transcribe Folder
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Transcribe every audio and video file in a folder into transcript or subtitle files.

commands.name: watch-folder
commands.title: Watch Folder
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Automatically transcribe new recordings added to a folder. Run it once to start watching; it then checks every 10 minutes.

preferences.name: watchedFolder
preferences.title: Watched Folder
preferences.description: New audio and video files in this folder (not its subfolders) get a transcript next to them.

preferences.name: watchFormat
preferences.title: Transcript Format
preferences.description: Format of the transcript written next to each new recording.

commands.name: export-presets
commands.title: Export Presets
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Save export settings (format, style, grouping, timestamps, line length, Avid fps) and transcribe with them in one step.

commands.name: manage-models
commands.title: Manage Models
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: List downloaded transcription models and switch the active one.

commands.name: active-model
commands.title: Active Model
commands.subtitle: MacWhisper
commands.description: Show MacWhisper's active model in the menu bar and switch models from there.

preferences.name: defaultLanguage
preferences.title: Default Language
preferences.description: Spoken language used when a command does not ask for one. Auto-detect works for most recordings.

preferences.name: recordingFolders
preferences.title: Recording Folders
preferences.description: Comma-separated folders searched for your latest recording (two levels deep).

preferences.name: saveToHistory
preferences.title: History
preferences.label: Save transcriptions to MacWhisper history
preferences.description: Pass --persist so transcriptions also appear in MacWhisper.

preferences.name: mwPath
preferences.title: mw CLI Path
preferences.description: Custom path to the MacWhisper `mw` CLI. Leave empty to auto-detect /usr/local/bin/mw or the copy inside MacWhisper.app.

tools.name: transcribe-audio
tools.title: Transcribe Audio
tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file (or the files selected in Finder) with MacWhisper and return the transcript, optionally as subtitles (srt/vtt), grouped by speaker, or saved to a file.

tools.name: list-recent-recordings
tools.title: List Recent Recordings
tools.description: List the newest audio and video files in the user's recording folders, to find their latest recording.

tools.name: list-models
tools.title: List Models
tools.description: List the transcription models downloaded in MacWhisper, the active model and the MacWhisper version.

tools.name: select-model
tools.title: Select Model
tools.description: Change MacWhisper's active transcription model to one of the downloaded models.

ai.instructions: MacWhisper transcribes audio and video files on-device. Use transcribe-audio to get a transcript; when the user does not give a path, call it without one to use the Finder selection. When the user refers to their latest or recent recording, call list-recent-recordings first and pass the newest path to transcribe-audio. Use the srt or vtt format when the user asks for subtitles, and groupBySpeaker for meetings, interviews and calls. When the user names a model, call list-models first and pass the exact model id. After transcribing, answer the user's actual request (summary, action items, translation, ...) from the transcript instead of dumping it, unless they asked for the raw transcript.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
